text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Biwa

Hayahide...

Those are so cute. I remember how much
I used to
love plushies.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
She's looking at a claw machine filled
with little
Umamusume plushies.

Brian and I used to have matching
plushies when
we were young.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It's hard to even imagine her playing
with one
now...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Her wistful expression as she gazes at
the plushies
gives me an idea.

A plushie at my age? Hmm. That's an
interesting
proposal.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It might be good to get back in touch
with my
inner child. But first, let's see if
you can get one
at all.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You sound pretty confident! Show me
your best,
then, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Теперь я ни за что не могу подвести!
